name: Login with Better Auth
summary: Self-hosted sign-in with Better Auth: a Vite and React app on a Hono API and Postgres, with emailed codes through Resend, Google and GitHub sign-in, a password with a confirmed email, linked accounts and signed-in devices.
runsOn: A Vite and React app served by a Hono API in Chromium, with Postgres in Docker
shows: Better Auth's own sessions, accounts and codes in your Postgres, read by invariants: one user per person, one account per provider link, signed-out sessions gone, one email per code
Emailed codes read with `mail.code`, Google's and GitHub's consent screens with no real app, a confirmation link read with `mail.link`, and a second browser signed out from the first
Brute force refused: a fourth code request in five minutes gets a 429, three wrong guesses kill the code, and `time.travel` expires it
`danwo matrix` faulting Resend, GitHub's token endpoint and Better Auth's own SQL, with `BETTER_AUTH_BUG` switches that turn a safeguard off
